reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

For celiac disease, testing for immunoglobulin G (lgG) endomysial antibodies (CPT code 86231), lgG deamidated gliadin peptide (CPT code 86258) and immuglobulin A (IgA) anti-tissue transgluaminase (CPT code 86364) IS REIMBURSABLE no more than once every 90 days.

More than two units of gammaglobulin (CPT code 82784) per date of service for the evaluation of celiac disease IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.
